description: This file defines asynchronous dependency functions for a FastAPI application, utilizing dependency injection via Depends and Annotated. It manages resources by creating dependencies and ensuring proper cleanup with try-finally blocks.

methods.name: dependency_a()
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function that creates and yields a dependency object dep_a, ensuring cleanup via dep_a.close().

methods.name: dependency_b(dep_a: Annotated[DepA, Depends(dependency_a)])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function that creates dep_b with dependency injection of dep_a, yields it, and ensures cleanup with dep_b.close(dep_a).

methods.name: dependency_c(dep_b: Annotated[DepB, Depends(dependency_b)])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function that creates dep_c with dependency injection of dep_b, yields it, and ensures cleanup with dep_c.close(dep_b).
